Johnson & Johnson's capital expenditures rose about 9.2% from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025. I used the "additions to property, plant and equipment" line in the cash flow statement as capital expenditures.

- Fiscal 2025: $4,832 million
- Fiscal 2024: $4,424 million

The change is (4,832 − 4,424) / 4,424 = 9.22%.

Both figures come from J&J's fiscal 2025 10-K and its 2024 annual report.
